# libreoffice-mcp

Headless LibreOffice convert + ODT template merge + extension MCP bridge (FastMCP 3.3).

## Tools

- libreoffice — portmanteau: status, convert, merge, list_templates, batch_pack, bridge_discover, bridge_call, help
- libreoffice_help — topic help (convert, merge, coworker, bridge, agentic)
- libreoffice_agentic_workflow — sampling-based multi-step goals (SEP-1577)
- show_libreoffice_status_card — Prefab status UI
- show_templates_card — Prefab template gallery

## Skills

skill://libreoffice-expert/SKILL.md, skill://coworker-pdf/SKILL.md

## Prompts

libreoffice_quick_start, libreoffice_coworker_pdf, libreoffice_convert_playbook

## Config

LIBREOFFICE_MCP_SOFFICE_PATH, LIBREOFFICE_MCP_EXTENSION_BRIDGE_URL, LIBREOFFICE_MCP_SAMPLING_BASE_URL, LIBREOFFICE_MCP_SAMPLING_MODEL

Backend: 10981 | Frontend: 10983 | MCP: http://localhost:10981/mcp
